newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Mystery bottle causes security alert at U.N..
newsitem.headline: Mystery bottle causes security alert at U.N..

text.p: A suspicious package addressed to Secretary-General Kofi Annan caused a sudden alert by security forces at the U.N. Earth Summit on Wednesday.
The New York fire department, police bomb squad, U.S. Secret Service and a joint terrorism task force were all alerted.

A U.N. spokesman said the package contained a bottle with about 2 ounces (60 grams) of colourless liquid whose chemical formula was analysed as 90 percent water, 9 percent ethyl-alcoho and one percent spearmint.
